item.title: Raised paving slab outside 58 Farmington Road, 2nd September
item.description:
I reported a raised paving slab outside my elderly father’s property outside 58 Farmington Road GL51 6AX about 2 weeks ago. We had notification that the repair had been completed. On checking the pavement today I noticed that it is an appalling repair, the first photo shows how the new slab rocks in situ making it more dangerous than before.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 61, Farmington Road, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.description:

item.title: Human waste & overnight parking, 2nd September
item.description:
The route between liddington road and the premier inn. Despite signs saying no overnight parking trucks are parking in the lay-by overnight. In turn the drivers have now taken to using the public footpath and bushes to use as a toilet there is human excrement on the footpath this is accompanied by toilet paper. This practice is absolutely disgusting. This is the second time I have reported this in a number of years

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Liddington Road, Elmbridge, Gloucester
